description: Designs multiscale chunking for RAG by embedding small units for retrieval precision and returning larger context for synthesis. Use when fixed-size chunks either lose surrounding context or dilute relevance in long documents, manuals, filings, or codebases. Covers sentence-window and parent-child or auto-merging strategies, base chunk sizing, and evaluation. Do not use when a single chunk scale already meets retrieval and generation needs.
